terms.definition: Earth spinning in place around its own axis; one full spin takes about 24 hours.
Earth travelling all the way around the Sun; one full lap takes about 365.25 days.
The imaginary line through the North and South Poles that Earth spins around.
Earth's roughly circular path around the Sun.
The imaginary line circling Earth exactly halfway between the poles.
Half of Earth — Northern, Southern, Eastern, or Western.
